title: Manchester City says goodbye to manager Pep Guardiola
summary: Widely touted as one of the best managers in Premier League history, Pep Guardiola has stepped down from his role at the helm of Manchester City on May 26. After ten glorious years, during which the 55-year-old oversaw 593 games - more than any other in the club's history - fans said goodbye to Guardiola at a trophy parade and after-party.
